title: The Big Game
summary: 受挫后进球:比赛里主角把球传丢很沮丧、对方领先,再试一次终于把球踢进,大家开心。
text: Today is a big day. {{name}} wants to play soccer. The game is now! {{name}} runs fast on the green grass. The ball comes near. {{name}} kicks it hard. But the ball goes to a friend. The friend is faster than {{name}}. {{name}} feels sad now. The other team is better today. They have one goal. {{name}} wants to try again. "I can do it!" says {{name}}. {{name}} likes to run and kick. Now the ball comes again. {{name}} looks at the goal. {{name}} kicks the ball high. The ball goes in! It is a goal! All the friends are happy. They jump and shout. {{name}} is happy too. The game is fun today. Brave kids never stop. {{name}} wants to play more soccer now!

glossary.zh: 进球;球门(足球比赛中把球踢进对方球门得分)

questions.prompt: What does {{name}} want to do today?
How does {{name}} feel after the friend gets the ball?
What happens at the end of the game?
